title: Low Water Pressure
shortDescription: Vaillant ecoTEC pressure has dropped below 0.5 bar.
fullDescription:
F.22 is the most common Vaillant ecoTEC fault. The unit has detected pressure below the operating threshold and shut down to protect the heat exchanger.

On ecoTEC plus and pro, top up via the integrated filling key (or external loop) until 1.0-1.5 bar cold and the F.22 will clear after a power cycle. Repeated F.22 indicates a leak or a waterlogged expansion vessel.
safetyWarning: Do not exceed 2 bar — the PRV will open.

causes.cause: Slow leak in radiators or piping
Filling key left in but valves closed

fixSteps.title: Top up via filling key
fixSteps.instruction: Insert the white filling key, open both valves until 1.2 bar, close, remove.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Press the reset button to clear F.22.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Check radiator vents, valves, and the PRV outlet outside.

whenToCallPro: Hidden leak or expansion vessel work.

faq.a: Once a year is normal; weekly means a leak.

title: Flame Detected With Gas Off
shortDescription: Phantom flame signal — possible stuck gas valve.
fullDescription:
F.27 means the ecoTEC control sees ionization (flame) when no flame should be present. Common causes: damp ignition electrode causing leakage, damaged ionization probe insulator, or a sticking gas valve.

F.27 is a safety lockout that should not be repeatedly reset.
safetyWarning: Possible stuck gas valve — call a Gas Safe engineer.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Off at the spur for 2 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Schedule service
fixSteps.instruction: Have a Gas Safe engineer inspect.

whenToCallPro: Always — stuck gas valve must be diagnosed by Gas Safe.

faq.a: Damp can cause leakage paths on the ignition assembly.

title: Ignition Failure At Start
shortDescription: Burner failed to ignite after retries.
fullDescription:
F.28 is the Vaillant ecoTEC ignition lockout. After three failed ignition attempts the boiler hard locks until reset.

Most common UK cause is gas supply issues (closed meter valve, low LP, air in line after meter swap). Other causes: fouled ignition rod, plugged condensate trap, failed gas valve.
safetyWarning: If you smell gas, evacuate and call 0800 111 999.

causes.cause: Closed gas valve at meter or boiler

fixSteps.title: Verify gas
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm another gas appliance lights normally.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Press Reset and observe ignition.

whenToCallPro: Gas Safe engineer for pressure verification.

faq.a: Yes — air in the line; the engineer should re-bleed.

title: Flame Loss During Run
fullDescription: F.29 is logged when the ecoTEC ignites successfully but loses flame during operation. Look for low gas pressure under load, oxidized ionization rod, or condensate flooding the burner.
safetyWarning: Repeated F.29 means an underlying fault — do not just keep resetting.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Press Reset and observe.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Have an engineer clean ionization rod and check gas pressure.

faq.a: Gas pressure droop on shared meters.

title: Gas Pressure Fault
shortDescription: Gas inlet pressure below required minimum.
fullDescription:
F.54 is logged when the ecoTEC's gas pressure switch reports low inlet pressure. The boiler refuses to start to avoid incomplete combustion.

Common causes are an undersized gas pipe to the boiler, supplier outage, or a closed meter valve.
safetyWarning: Gas Safe required for any gas-pressure work.

fixSteps.title: Verify gas
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm meter valve open and other appliances work.

faq.a: Yes — common after upstream supply work.

title: Gas Valve Drive Fault
shortDescription: Internal gas valve circuit fault detected.
fullDescription: F.61 indicates a fault in the gas valve drive circuit. The PCB cannot guarantee safe gas valve closure.
safetyWarning: Treat as a serious gas-valve fault.

fixSteps.title: Isolate gas
fixSteps.instruction: Close the gas valve at the boiler.

fixSteps.title: Call Gas Safe engineer
fixSteps.instruction: Engineer to diagnose PCB and gas valve.

faq.a: No — fix before relying on heat.

title: Gas Valve Shut-Off Delay
shortDescription: Gas valve did not close in time.
fullDescription: F.62 is reported when the gas valve takes longer than allowed to close at end of cycle. PCB or gas-valve coil fault.

fixSteps.title: Isolate gas
fixSteps.instruction: Close gas valve.

fixSteps.title: Schedule engineer
fixSteps.instruction: Gas Safe engineer to inspect.

faq.a: Aged gas valve solenoids on older ecoTEC.

title: Pressure Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Pressure transducer signal out of range.
fullDescription: F.74 means the pressure sensor reads outside the valid range — often an open or shorted harness. The boiler cannot trust pressure readings and locks out.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat transducer harness.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Replace OEM transducer.

whenToCallPro: Gas Safe engineer for any internal work.

faq.a: Yes, but sensor signal is bad.

title: Pump / Pressure Sensor Fault
shortDescription: No pressure rise when pump starts.
fullDescription:
F.75 is one of the most common Vaillant fault codes. The boiler expects to see a small pressure rise when the pump starts; if it does not, F.75 is logged.

Causes include a failed/seized pump, waterlogged expansion vessel, faulty pressure sensor, or air in the boiler.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass — the pump test is a flow safety check.

fixSteps.title: Bleed
fixSteps.instruction: Bleed radiators and the boiler at the pump bleed screw.

fixSteps.title: Free pump
fixSteps.instruction: Free the pump shaft via the central slotted screw.

whenToCallPro: Pump replacement or expansion vessel work.

faq.a: Standing pumps seize after summer; recharge expansion vessel annually.

title: Water Pressure Sensor Open
fullDescription: F.73 is the open-circuit variant of F.74. Pressure transducer is disconnected or failed open.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat transducer connector.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Swap OEM transducer.

faq.a: F.73 is open, F.74 is range fault.
